notes: Assigned original fields only. Source title/authors verified. Rendered PDF p.125 (PDF page 7) inspected for table layout and significance stars. Target ambiguous: the supplied description “Children’s perceived mental effort for reading versus watching TV.” and p.125 locator do not identify which Table 1 AIME measure is intended. Candidates: pre-exposure AIME t = -2.87, p < .01 (two stars); general AIME t = -3.11, p < .01 (two stars); post-exposure AIME t = -2.21, p < .05 (one star). The post-exposure narrative additionally prints r = .27; requested test-statistic metric would instead retain t if that target were established. No metric conversion performed. Preconception columns each show n = 64 for the same children rating both media (not 128 independent participants). Post-test columns show mutually exclusive television n = 32 and print n = 32, giving 32 + 32 = 64 participants for that comparison. These are candidate-specific analytic roles, not a selected target N; no N inferred from df. Exclusions are not specified. All assigned values remain null pending identification of the intended AIME measure. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
